subject.title: Image tool fails to resolve media:// protocol paths for inbound Discord media

question: Should this issue wait for live Discord DM reproduction before any repair, or should the related media-retention cluster be treated as canonical without Discord-specific proof?
rationale: The generic resolver is covered on main, but the reported Discord failure is only source-plausible; choosing a fix path without live proof risks changing the wrong media boundary.

options.title: Require live Discord proof
options.body: Capture the saved path, emitted `media://inbound/<id>`, active `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, and image-tool result on current main before queueing a fix.

options.title: Fold into the retention cluster
options.body: Treat this as the same remaining work as the open WhatsApp resolver report, while keeping this issue linked for Discord-specific evidence.

recommendation.title: Require live Discord proof
recommendation.body: Capture the saved path, emitted `media://inbound/<id>`, active `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, and image-tool result on current main before queueing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing owner from the shared media-reference and recent Discord media history.
